import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RegularDifferentialExtension

/-!
# Generic-point and neighborhood API for regular differentials

The intrinsic lattice of regular rational differentials is unrestricted at the
generic point.  Consequently, membership in the regular differential module
on a nonempty open gives lattice membership at every point, including the
generic point.  Together with local extension, this gives the neighborhood
characterization of the intrinsic lattice.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

private theorem differential_range_eq_top (R A B : Type*)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Field B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower R A B]
    (h : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A B)) :
    LinearMap.range (KaehlerDifferential.map R R A B) = ⊤ :=
  LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (KaehlerDifferential.map_surjective_of_surjective R R A B h)

private theorem mem_submodule_of_eq_top {R M : Type*} [Semiring R]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (L : Submodule R M) (hL : L = ⊤) (m : M) :
    m ∈ L := hL ▸ Submodule.mem_top

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]

/-- Every rational differential is regular at the generic point. -/
theorem curveRegularDifferentialLattice_genericPoint_top :
    curveRegularDifferentialLattice X (genericPoint X.left) = ⊤ := by
  unfold curveRegularDifferentialLattice regularDifferentialLattice
  refine @differential_range_eq_top k (X.left.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X.left))
    X.left.functionField _ _ _ (stalkOverAlgebra k X.left (genericPoint X.left))
    (functionFieldOverAlgebra k X.left)
    (stalkFunctionFieldAlgebra X.left (genericPoint X.left))
    (stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower X (genericPoint X.left)) ?_
  intro a
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  change (X.left.presheaf.stalkSpecializes
    ((genericPoint_spec X.left).specializes trivial)).hom a = a
  rw [show ((genericPoint_spec X.left).specializes trivial) =
    specializes_refl (genericPoint X.left) from Subsingleton.elim _ _]
  rw [X.left.presheaf.stalkSpecializes_refl]
  rfl

/-- A regular section on a nonempty open belongs to the intrinsic lattice at
every point of that open. -/
theorem mem_curveRegularDifferentialLattice_of_mem_regularDifferentialSections
    {U : X.left.Opens} (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty)
    {η : CurveRationalDifferentials X} (hη : η ∈ regularDifferentialSections X U)
    (x : X.left) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
    η ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  by_cases hx : x = genericPoint X.left
  · subst x
    letI : Algebra (X.left.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X.left)) X.left.functionField :=
      stalkFunctionFieldAlgebra X.left (genericPoint X.left)
    exact @mem_submodule_of_eq_top _ _ _ _ _ _
      (curveRegularDifferentialLattice_genericPoint_top X) η
  · exact (mem_regularDifferentialSections_of_nonempty X hU).mp hη x hx hxU

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- A rational differential is in the intrinsic local lattice exactly when it
is represented by a regular section on some neighborhood. -/
theorem mem_curveRegularDifferentialLattice_iff_exists_regularDifferentialSections
    (x : X.left) (η : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :
    η ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x ↔
      ∃ U : X.left.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ η ∈ regularDifferentialSections X U := by
  refine ⟨exists_regularDifferentialSections_of_mem_lattice X x η, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨U, hxU, hη⟩
  exact mem_curveRegularDifferentialLattice_of_mem_regularDifferentialSections
    X ⟨x, hxU⟩ hη x hxU

end
end Hartshorne
